summary: Brera Holdings PLC, operating as Solmate Infrastructure (NASDAQ: SLMT), furnished a Form 6-K on August 20, 2026 disclosing the purchase of an additional 1,000 SOL, lifting aggregate holdings to roughly 1.25 million SOL. At a $85 per SOL Kraken reference price as of 16:30 EDT August 19, 2026, the treasury exceeded $100 million market value, unaudited. The filing is a routine digital-asset treasury update with a press release exhibit, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics beyond custody, staking, and liquidity caveats. Watch SOL price volatility and disclosure of further purchases or sales.
